item.title: With central role for Qatar, can Gulf states mediate between US and Venezuela?
item.description: Venezuela's ties improved with Gulf states under Maduro, and some in the region voiced concern about the US operation.

item.title: Iran protests enter second week as Ghalibaf warns of 'foreign' actors
item.description: Senior Iranian officials have begun pointing to foreign actors to explain the ongoing nationwide protests.

item.title: Israel says targets Hezbollah, Hamas in Lebanon strikes
item.description: The Israeli military launched strikes on southern and eastern Lebanon on Monday, Lebanese state media reported, after warning it would hit what it called Hezbollah and Hamas targets in four villages.It was the first such warning issued by the Israeli military this year, as Israel continues to strike targets in Lebanon despite a ceasefire with Hezbollah.

item.title: Delegation led by Yemen's main separatist group to travel to Saudi Arabia, sources say
item.description: CAIRO, Jan 5 (Reuters) - A delegation led by Yemen's main separatist group STC leader Aidarous al-Zubaidi will travel to Saudi Arabia, two sources told Reuters on Monday.The visit would come days after STC welcomed a call for dialogue by Saudi Arabia to end a recent military escalation that has opened a major feud between Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. (Writing by Menna Alaa El-Din)

item.title: Where's next? Trump eyes new targets after Venezuela
item.description: An emboldened US President Donald Trump has hinted that he has other countries in his sights after toppling Venezuela's Nicolas Maduro, leaving the world asking: where's next?
